Attached: 1 image

Armbian for Amlogic, Rockchip, and Allwinner devices brings Linux to a wide range of TV boxes, including models without official support.

Replace Android TV with Armbian and use your device as a small server, with Docker support, kernel updates, eMMC/SD/USB storage, and backup tools.

⚠️ This is an independent Armbian-based project, not the official Armbian repository.

More details : https://digitalescapetools.com/tools/armbian.html
